findings.reader: A tight, accurate bounded news piece: it answers the reader job (what protections a district can request, which tools remain outside) with a clear two-gate mechanism — covered education product plus opted-in agreement — defines every technical term in context, preserves attributed criticism and open vendor questions, and ends with a specific, proportionate parental action. No failure families present; explain-back and a novel transfer scenario both succeed from article content alone.
findings.facts: Every material claim checks out against the supplied sources: the Sept 7 MOA signatures, the Sept 9 joint Microsoft/AFT/UFT announcement, the incorporation-makes-enforceable mechanism, the opt-in/request process, the exclusion of general-purpose products, the training prohibition and its narrow purpose-limited safety exception, the companion-feature ban, the telemetry carve-out, the incorrectness-notice requirement, and the AP-attributed criticism and vendor status. Attribution and scope limits are faithfully retained; no contradictions or overreach found.
